## Checklist

- [ ] Every domain is reserved (`.test`, `.example`…) and every address private. No real company, person or product is targeted.
- [ ] The mission teaches a class of weakness. Nothing in it works as-is against a real system: no real exploit, no real payload, no real CVE.
- [ ] The story stays under a signed mandate, and the debrief explains how to defend.
- [ ] Suitable for players aged 16 and over: no violence, nothing shocking.
- [ ] `solution.txt` finishes the mission, and `check` passes locally.
- [ ] I played it in the game at the three guidance levels, in order and out of order.
- [ ] I changed the `version` of every pack I modified.
- [ ] I agree to publish this content under the repository's licence.
